name: Stamped
summary: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.
best_for: mid-market Shopify brands that want reviews and loyalty in one platform instead of juggling separate apps
skip_if: you're an early-stage store: the removed free plan and $199+/product pricing are steep before you have the volume to justify them
honest_knock: The ladder climbs at every order step. Reviews runs from $23 a month at 200 orders to $799 on Unlimited, Repeat from $299 at 5,000 orders to $1,999, and crossing 5,000 orders doubles Reviews from $99 to $199. Loyalty is no longer priced on the page, while the FAQ still quotes $798 for multi-product access, so anyone buying more than one product depends on a sales quote. A further storefront is another $100 a month. Start with one product and price the step above the volume you actually expect.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month at the 200-order volume step (no free plan)
pricing.notes: (re-read 16 November 2026 by plain fetch of stamped.io/pricing; the amount for each order step sits in the page's own HTML, in the data its order-volume selector reads) There is no free plan, and the bill follows monthly order volume per product. The page now shows two product cards, Repeat and Reviews. Reviews is $23 a month at 200 orders, $99 at 1,000, $199 at 5,000, $399 at 20,000, $599 at 50,000 and $799 on Unlimited. Repeat shows no price at 200 or 1,000 orders and costs $299 at 5,000, $499 at 20,000, $999 at 50,000 and $1,999 on Unlimited. On 12 September 2026 the 5,000 step listed Repeat at $499 and Loyalty at $299 with a Multi-Product Bundle at $798, and every step from 20,000 up read "Custom plan — Talk to Sales". On 16 November there is no Loyalty card and no bundle card, while the FAQ on the same page still says plans start at $199 a month for a single product and $798 a month for multi-product access, and that all plans include unlimited orders. A pop-up offers 50% off a Stamped plan until the end of 2026, for new customers only and only after a call with the sales team. Plans include up to two domains, each additional store gets its first month free, and additional domains are $100/month each. Stamped's terms say fees exclude taxes. The page says nothing about overage charges.
